a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first leaves both of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. Once I have my 4, I'll keep operating with you every round after that so you can get yours.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
